findings.summary: The revoke step (sharing revoked, pending deliveries cancelled, Block recorded) now runs before the confirm/cancel branch b6. This contradicts the Block affordance's effect that nothing is revoked or recorded until the owner confirms in BlockConfirmDialog.
The cancel path reaches e2 'No block recorded' only after b3 has already recorded the Block and revoked sharing, so the end state is inconsistent with the flow.

The new claim that cancelling a block confirmation leaves sharing and pending jobs untouched cannot hold, because the journey revokes sharing and cancels deliveries in b3 before the cancel branch in b6.
